about: The frame of the previous shot's take a previous_last continuity starts from.
rule: index = floor(last_source_frame * take_fps * fps.den / fps.num), where take_fps is the fps of the take's asset (24 without one) and fps the timeline's. total = the asset's frame_count, else the take's frames, else planned_frames (at least 1); a take that did not succeed has no asset. The answer is max(0, index) when index < total - 1, and null (the last decodable frame of the take) otherwise. take null is a take that is rendered in the same run. take carries only the fields the rule reads.

vectors.name: the last frame of the take is asked for as the last decodable frame
a 30 fps timeline over a 24 fps take
a take rendered in the same run is judged by the planned length
the planned last frame of a take rendered in the same run
a take that did not succeed counts by its requested frames
